Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly instructed corroboration using authoritative sources (e.g., ThePeerage and Foundation for Medieval Genealogy) in Step 6, WebSurfer failed to follow those directions and instead performed another generic/quoted search that yielded no progress. This reliance on search snippets and repetition of general queries, without opening and verifying from the requested authoritative sources, perpetuated the conflict (2 August 1288 vs 8 February 1288) and risked settling on an incorrect date rather than confirming the correct 2 August 1288.
